reviews.comment: Dr. Ziff is the absolute best! Her lectures were clear and well organized, and she would stop periodically to make sure everyone was on the same page. She gave great feedback throughout the semester on our project checkpoints/homework. I cannot recommend this class and Dr. Ziff enough!

reviews.comment: Professor Ziff was probably the best professor I had during my time at Texas A&M. She makes things easy to learn and gives you many opportunities to succeed. Attend class and pay attention and you'll pass the class with ease. This class is also great for developing coding skills, no previous experience required.

Professor Ziff is one of the best professors I've had. She teaches very well, explains well, puts her students in mind, and answers all your questions. Very patient and caring. Class was definitely interesting. No prior R skills required, she will teach you. I recommend this class if you're interested in data analysis. Opennoteexams,groupproject.
